name: Mobile Car Detailing
tagline: Wash, detail, ceramic coating, interior, fleet
extra_prompt: You are booking for a mobile car detailing service. Ask about the vehicle make, model, size, condition, and what needs attention. Ask whether it is a daily driver, a show car, or pre-sale. Ask about water and power access at the location. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed after seeing the car. Do not promise specific results for severe paint defects without inspection.

kb.a: {price_note} Pricing depends on vehicle size and condition. We confirm after inspecting the car.
Yes, we are a mobile service. We need access to water and power, or we can bring our own.
Yes, including paint preparation before the coating goes on. We quote from the price list, and the final cost depends on the car.
Yes, we offer single and multi-stage correction. Severe paint defects are assessed on inspection, so results are confirmed after we look at the paint.
Yes, including steam, shampoo, and leather care. Tell us about stains or odours so we can plan the work.
Yes, pet hair removal is available as an add-on to any detail. Tell us what type of pet, so we bring the right tools.
Yes, we treat odours with ozone or enzyme treatments, depending on the source. We confirm the treatment after we inspect the car.

kb.q: Do you do engine bay cleaning?
kb.a: Yes, engine bay cleaning is available. We only work on the engine bay once the engine has cooled and the car is safe to work on.
Yes, we restore headlights, priced per pair. Results depend on how far the lens has yellowed, so we confirm after inspecting them.
Yes, we detail fleet vehicles per vehicle, including ongoing fleet contracts. Tell us how many vehicles you have and how often they need work.
Yes, we do pre-sale details to help the car present well for buyers. Tell us your sale date so we can plan the work.

kb.q: How long does a detail take?
kb.a: A wash takes about 1 hour. Paint correction and ceramic coating can take a full day or longer.

kb.q: Do you do boats and caravans?
kb.a: We can quote boats and caravans on request. Tell us the size and condition so we can give you a sensible estimate.

kb.q: Do you bring water and power?
kb.a: Yes. If you do not have water or power at the location, we bring our own.
We hold [insurance type and amount] cover. Ask us for a certificate before the visit.
We service the local metro area. Ask us to confirm your suburb before you book.

kb.q: Do I need to be there while you work?
kb.a: You do not have to stay for the whole job, but we need access to the car and a clear place to work. Tell us if you prefer to stay.

kb.q: Do I need to clear the car first?
kb.a: Please remove valuables and personal items before we arrive, so we can clean every surface properly.
